findings.observation: binding_energy of -6.79 kcal/mol is internally consistent across metadata, results, and prose, but is roughly twice the accepted benzene-water benchmark (approx. -3.3 kcal/mol at CCSD(T)/CBS, S22 set); counterpoise-corrected plain PBE/cc-pVDZ would be expected to bind more weakly, so the magnitude is physically implausible. No numbered rule covers agreement with external literature, so per CA-META-003 this judgement call is recorded as ADVISORY only and does not gate.
